recipe.title: Overnight Crockpot Protein French Toast
recipe.summary: Warm cinnamon French toast casserole with eggs, cottage cheese, vanilla protein, and berries, ready when the family wakes up.
recipe.story: Load the slow cooker before bed, set the timer, and wake up to a hot family breakfast with enough protein to actually keep everyone full.
recipe.serving_size: 1/6 of the French toast casserole | 1/2 cup berries
ingredients: 12 slices Sara Lee Delightful White Made with Whole Grain Bread, cubed
3 scoops Clean Simple Eats Simply Vanilla Protein Powder

ingredient_sections.title: French Toast Casserole
items: 12 slices Sara Lee Delightful White Made with Whole Grain Bread, cubed
3 scoops Clean Simple Eats Simply Vanilla Protein Powder

instructions: Lightly spray the insert of a 6-quart slow cooker with avocado oil.
Add the bread cubes in an even layer.
Blend the eggs, egg whites, cottage cheese, protein powder, almond milk, vanilla, cinnamon, and salt until completely smooth.
Pour the mixture evenly over the bread. Gently press the bread down so every piece is coated.
Cover and refrigerate the slow-cooker insert for up to 8 hours, or place it directly in the slow cooker if cooking immediately.
Set the slow cooker to LOW for 6 hours. Use a programmable slow cooker so it automatically switches to WARM when cooking is complete.
Turn off the slow cooker after no more than 2 hours on WARM. Divide the casserole into 6 equal portions.
Serve each portion with 1/2 cup berries and optional sugar-free maple syrup.
freezer_storage: Cool the cooked casserole completely and divide into individual portions.
If four servings remain, use a gallon-size freezer bag. If fewer than four servings remain, use quart-size freezer bags.
Separate portions with parchment, remove excess air, and freeze for up to 2 months. Freeze the berries separately.
reheating_instructions: Microwave one portion for 60 seconds, then continue in 20-second intervals until hot.
Add fresh or thawed berries after reheating.
tips: A programmable slow cooker is required for a true overnight cook so the edges do not overcook.
Do not leave the casserole on WARM longer than 2 hours.
